proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_ability_set
proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines shared passive grants with multiple named item abilities that have different trigger/cost/resource shapes and separate once-per-dawn usage tracking.
proposed_widenings.evidence: It also has the following additional properties. Once one of these properties is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_damage_roll_numeric
proposed_widenings.justification: The passive quarterstaff bonus includes weapon damage-roll modification, which the current effect vocabulary cannot express.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it.

proposed_widenings.name: weapon_filter.specific_item_or_weapon
proposed_widenings.justification: The passive bonus is scoped to attacks and damage made with this specific staff, but current weapon filters only distinguish melee versus ranged.

notes: No content file was authored. The item does not fit a single existing MagicItemMechanics family honestly, and forcing it into passive-only or activation-only would omit core mechanics.
